summary: Comprehensive multi-layer test suite with excellent coverage of all three retention policies (age, size, keep-latest-N), policy combinations, dry-run mode, CLI wrapper, and full pipeline integration via act. Includes static workflow validation and deterministic test data with hand-computed expected values. Strengths: clean separation of unit/CLI/integration/workflow tests, fixture-driven design, exact value assertions (not just 'should contain'), error path testing, full act pipeline execution. Minor weaknesses: some edge cases (artifact collisions, future dates, concurrency) not explicitly covered; fixture data itself not inspectable in this review; module installation in workflow tests could fail in constrained environments. Would reliably catch regressions in core logic and most edge cases.
